Amazing restaurant in Hanoi
Apr 2025 • Family
We had a wonderful family dinner at GÓC and it was truly one of the highlights of our trip. The food was outstanding — every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. The grilled skewers were a real standout, full of smoky aroma and just the right amount of seasoning.

The atmosphere was equally impressive. GÓC offers a cozy, intimate space with thoughtful design touches that make you feel instantly at ease. There’s a perfect balance between tradition and modern style — it feels special without being pretentious.

Service was attentive and warm, making our evening even more enjoyable.
Highly recommended if you’re looking for a place that delivers both amazing food and an unforgettable dining experience.

We will definitely be back!

truly impressive culinary experience
Aug 2023 • Friends
I visited the restaurant with my friend last week and it's truly impressive experience. I used to visit the Tách space to drink coffee, but it was only last week that I discovered there's a restaurant inside.

Food: The establishment seems to specialize in grilled dishes, which are quite suitable for casual dining and drinking. Since we went during lunchtime, my friend and I ordered a Beef Udon and a Seafood Rice. I was quite impressed with the sauce of the seafood rice I had; the flavor was rich and the sweet and sour taste was my cup of tea. The set meal was quite comprehensive, including a soup and dessert.

Ambiance: The restaurant's style left a strong impression on me, with a vintage touch that truly embodies Hanoi's essence. The spacious layout ensures that clothes don't retain any lingering odors after dining.

Service: The day I visited, the restaurant was fairly crowded, but the staff was quick in their service. They provided enthusiastic recommendations for suitable beverages to complement each dish.

Definitely will come back for dinner and drink!!!!
